subject: Onboarding cadence and decision gates for SolSugar MAP
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@solsugar.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding cadence and decision gates for SolSugar MAP

Jordan — great to meet virtually last week. As discussed, I put together a first-pass mutual action plan and a lightweight cadence that balances your internal SSO/legal milestones with our delivery windows. Key asks in this note: please confirm the two decision gates we listed (security signoff and production dataset access), and tell us whether Priya will own the internal resource approvals.

I attached an editable MAP (SolSugar_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a SOW draft — both are intentionally high level so we can tighten the dates once you confirm owners. Proposed milestones (high level):
- Week 0: Contract signature + SSO scope agreement (owner: SolSugar Legal)
- Week 1–2: Test environment provisioning + sample data handoff (owner: SolSugar Eng)
- Week 3–4: Model mapping and inference validation (owner: Redwood eng)
- Week 5: Cutover rehearsal/bridge call (owners: Redwood CS + SolSugar Eng)
- Week 6: Go-live (owner: SolSugar product)

Open items I want to resolve this week:
1) Confirmation of Priya as internal approver for data access
2) Whether you need a dedicated throughput commitment (we recommended Dedicated pool in the SOW)
3) Any blackout dates between Jun 21–30 (we've blocked those tentatively)

Can you and Priya reply with availability for a 30–45 minute alignment call tomorrow (Wed) or Thursday afternoon? Once we lock owners/dates, Monica will own the handoff checklist into CS and Ben will scope integration dependencies.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

— Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SolSugar_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@solsugar.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@solsugar.com>, acct-success@solsugar.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence and decision gates for SolSugar MAP

Naomi — thanks, this is helpful and exactly the level we need. Quick answers: Priya will be the approver for internal data access and legal will be the signoff for the contract gate. We don’t have any blackout dates the week of Jun 21–30; that window works for our infra team.

Two asks from our side: 1) can you push the provisional dates out one week later than your proposal? Our infra lead is on a product launch the week of Jun 21. 2) We need clarity on the Dedicated pool pricing — Priya will want the line-item in the SOW.

I’m available Thu 15 Jun 14:00–15:00 PT for a 30m call. If that works, please send an invite.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP Product, SolSugar Inc.
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@solsugar.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence and decision gates for SolSugar MAP

Jordan — perfect, thanks for the quick confirmations. I updated the spreadsheet to shift the provisional timeline one week later and included a clear line item for Dedicated pool pricing in the SOW. Links below:
- MAP (editable): https://drive.redwood.com/solsugar/MAP_v1 (tab: timeline + owners)
- SOW draft with Dedicated line: https://drive.redwood.com/solsugar/SOW_draft

I’m locking Thu 15 Jun 14:00 PT for a 30m alignment — invite sent. Monica: please prepare the CS handoff checklist (acceptance criteria, reporting hooks, bridge-runbook owner) and attach the checklist to the shared MAP. Ben: can you capture the minimal integration dependencies (SSO, sample data format, schema expectations) and drop integration-deps.csv in the drive by EOD today?

On the call we should confirm: final Go/No-go gate criteria, who on SolSugar approves the acceptance test, and whether we need a one-week canary after go-live. If Priya can’t make the call, Jordan, please confirm an alternate.

— Naomi

Forwarded attachment stubs: SolSugar_MAP_v1.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@solsugar.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence and decision gates for SolSugar MAP

Quick tech notes from my side — I populated a draft integration-deps.csv in the shared drive with the items we discussed:
- SSO: OIDC details + JWKS endpoint (need SolSugar to provide tenant ID)
- Data: sample JSON schema + 5 anonymized rows for validation (we asked for these by EOD Thu)
- Network: allowlist IPs for staging cluster (I put temporary placeholders)

Risk callouts: if sample data is delayed > 5 business days, validation will push the go-live by at least two weeks. Also, if SolSugar prefers encrypted at-rest snapshots instead of direct staging access, that adds 3 business days for our infra setup.

I’ll be on the Thu 14:00 PT call and can run through the integration checklist.

— Ben
Attachment referenced: integration-deps.csv (stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@solsugar.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence and decision gates for SolSugar MAP

Jordan/Team — thanks for the call earlier. Summary and next steps (action owners included):
- Contract signature: SolSugar Legal (Priya) target: 2027-06-22
- Staging access + sample data: SolSugar Eng (Jordan) target: 2027-06-28
- Integration validation window: Redwood eng (Ben) target: 2027-07-05
- Cutover rehearsal: Redwood CS (Monica) + SolSugar Eng target: 2027-07-08
- Go-live (canary + full): SolSugar product + Redwood CS target: canary 2027-07-12, full 2027-07-19

I attached the CS handoff checklist to the MAP and added acceptance criteria: (1) latency < 350ms P95 in staging, (2) end-to-end inference correctness validation (test set pass rate >= 94%), (3) monitoring hooks in place with alert thresholds.

If anything here looks off, flag it in the MAP spreadsheet comments. I will open a HubSpot task (linked) for weekly status updates until full handoff is complete.

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/56789
